column1: # Corpus for scripts/hook-fork-census.sh — executed-path fork census of hooks/validate-bash.sh
# FORMAT (tab-separated, 3 fields):   class <TAB> run_in_background <TAB> command
# 🚨 EVERY DANGER STRING LIVES IN THIS FILE AND NOWHERE ELSE. The live validate-bash.sh hook
# fires on every Bash tool call, so a literal danger pattern typed into a tool call gets the
# agent's OWN call denied. The census feeds the hook from this file; no danger literal is ever
# an argument to a command. Do not inline these anywhere else.
# Command lengths are calibrated to the real fleet distribution, measured 2026-08-17 over the
# last 4000 lines of ~/.claude/logs/bash-commands.log:
#   min=0  p25=18  median=55  p75=100  p95=199  max=1267 characters.
# (Caveat: that logger writes heredoc bodies as their own lines, so the tail is inflated by
# body text; the central percentiles are the trustworthy part and are what the corpus targets.)
# CLASSES — one per distinct executed path through the hook:
#   safe-short     ordinary safe command, ~median length      → runs the FULL gauntlet, no deny
#   safe-median    ordinary safe command at the p50 length    → full gauntlet
#   safe-long      ordinary safe command near p95             → full gauntlet, longer subject
#   git-command    a git command that is NOT denied           → full gauntlet + git terms
#   rm-safe        rm present, target safe                    → arms the rm argv scan, allows
#   bg-benign      run_in_background, self-terminating        → goal-guard shape scan, allows
#   bg-park        run_in_background poll loop                → goal-guard DENY (early return)
#   pane-spawn     a pane-spawn command                       → sources the lease + lineage libs
#   deny-early     first hard-deny pattern in the file        → shortest deny path
#   deny-flag      a real-flag deny (shlex path)              → is-true-flag.sh library path
#   deny-ddl       DDL deny                                   → mid-file deny
#   deny-rm        catastrophic rm target                     → rm argv scan then deny
safe-short
safe-median
safe-long
